gizmo.title: Umaka / Iphilisi
gizmo.description: Ilebula ehlangene emise okwephilisi enombala wokugcizelela, inkinobho yokukhansela, noma isishintshi ongakukhetha.

configure.title: Umbala wokugcizelela

configure.title: Umbala wokugcizelela ozenzakalelayo

configure.title: Inkinobho yokukhansela
configure.description: Bonisa inkinobho yesithonjana sokususa/ukukhansela ngaphakathi kwephilisi.

configure.title: Ukufunda kuphela
configure.description: Fihla inkinobho yokukhansela ukuze iphilisi libe ngelokubonisa kuphela.

advanced.title: Iyashintsha
advanced.description: Yenza iphilisi lishintshe livuleke/livaleke lapho inkinobho ichofozwa.
